In this paper, we address this gap by first illustrating how Large Language Models (LLMs) can be instrumental in extracting dialogue policies from datasets, through the conversion of conversations into a unified intermediate representation consisting of canonical forms.
By combining canonical forms across conversations into a flow network, we find that running graph traversal algorithms helps in extracting dialogue flows.
